# Multi-Tab Browser Navigation Demo

## Overview
This demo simulates browsing two different websites in separate browser tabs:
1. Shopping Site - A retail website with product categories
2. Forum - A brand showcase platform

## How to Use
1. Open `dual_sites.html` in a web browser
2. The Shopping Site tab will be active by default
3. Click on the "Forum" tab to switch to the brand showcase
4. Click on the "Shopping Site" tab to switch back

## Implementation Details
- Uses HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to simulate tabbed browsing
- Each "tab" loads content in an iframe
- Simple JavaScript handles tab switching functionality
- Responsive design works on desktop and mobile devices

## File Structure
- `dual_sites.html` - Main demo page with tabbed interface
- `../shopping_site.html` - Shopping site content (loaded in iframe)
- `../brand_showcase.html` - Forum content (loaded in iframe)

## Success Criteria Met
✅ Two websites open in separate tabs (simulated)
✅ Ability to switch between tabs
✅ Content loads correctly in each tab
